scope.boundary: Muscles that move the hand, wrist, and forearm rotation. A muscle is in scope when at least one end attaches to the hand (carpals, metacarpals, phalanges, or palmar soft tissue) or a finger, or when it rotates the forearm (pronator teres, pronator quadratus, supinator), because the simulation includes forearm rotation. Muscles that act mainly at the elbow (brachioradialis, anconeus) are excluded. Bones cover the hand plus the radius and ulna.
counting_rules: Count 8 carpals, 5 metacarpals, and 14 phalanges as 27 hand bones; add radius and ulna for 29. Include the pisiform among carpals; exclude other sesamoids and accessory bones.

Count 18 forearm muscles: 8 anterior and 10 posterior. 15 insert on the hand (palmaris longus counts because it inserts into the palmar aponeurosis); pronator teres, pronator quadratus, and supinator are included as forearm rotators.
Count 19 intrinsic hand muscles: 4 thumb muscles, 3 hypothenar muscles, palmaris brevis, 4 lumbricals, 4 dorsal interossei, and 3 palmar interossei. Adductor pollicis counts once despite two heads.
Count each named muscle once; FDS, FDP, and extensor digitorum each count once despite four modeled digital actuators. Do not equate anatomical totals with actuator totals.
variations: Palmaris longus can be absent; this reference inventory includes it.
Use the three-palmar-interossei convention; a separately described thumb palmar interosseous and accessory muscles are outside this count.
Origins and insertions are attachment summaries, not specimen-specific coordinates. Head variants and accessory slips are not enumerated.
model_limits: MyoHand has 39 actuators. 5 actuators from MUSIC (APB_r, FPB_r, AdP_r, ADM_r, FDM_r) are added when the MUSIC cache is present, giving 44. Twelve finger intrinsic channels retain bundled model labels because an exact muscle-by-muscle correspondence has not been established.
Empty model_actuators means no confirmed dedicated actuator; a muscle may contribute to a bundled channel without an established mapping.
Forearm rotation (pro_sup_r) has two pronator actuators (PT_r, PQ_r) and no supinator, as in MyoHand and MUSIC.
The anatomical inventory is a research reference. Muscle paths, joint axes, limits, and posture-dependent moment arms must be read from the exported model catalog.

conventions.abduction: Fingers move away from digit 3; thumb abduction has a different anatomical plane.
conventions.coordinate_units: Anatomical descriptions use named directions; numeric model geometry uses metres and joint angles use radians. Refer to the model catalog for axis frames and signs.

excluded_muscles.name: Brachioradialis
excluded_muscles.reason: Runs from the humerus to the distal radius; it acts mainly at the elbow and does not attach to the hand.

excluded_muscles.name: Anconeus
excluded_muscles.reason: Runs from the humerus to the ulna; it acts at the elbow and does not attach to the hand.
